nodes.label: ask_expert Tool (Sonnet delegates to Opus)
nodes.rationale: Runs hard tasks one-shot on Opus so most messages never touch Opus; long expert answers go to the canvas so Sonnet only summarises.

nodes.label: Canvas (images and cards UI)
nodes.rationale: Claude cannot edit pixels itself; tools push UI events to the frontend.

nodes.label: image_edit Tool (Pillow, versioned)
nodes.rationale: Each edit creates a new version so undo/redo comes for free.

nodes.label: Model Router (router.py: Haiku/Sonnet/Opus)
nodes.rationale: Cheap/fast models by default so Pro usage limits last; strong models only for heavy tasks.

nodes.label: Sticky Routing
nodes.rationale: Switching models re-sends the whole conversation; past ~20K tokens automatic picks never downgrade.

nodes.label: 3D Objects Preview Mode (Phase 4d)
nodes.rationale: Fast low-detail preview first; final file only after user approval.

nodes.label: Claude Never Writes Code That Runs Locally
nodes.norm_label: claude never writes code that runs locally
nodes.rationale: Claude only writes the JSON spec; fixed scripts build it, since running generated Blender Python could be steered by malicious web pages or emails.

nodes.label: Scene Spec (JSON list of parts)
nodes.rationale: One description, two builds: preview and final built from the same spec so the final matches the approved shape.

nodes.label: trimesh + geometry deps (numpy, shapely, mapbox-earcut, scipy, rtree)
nodes.norm_label: trimesh + geometry deps (numpy, shapely, mapbox-earcut, scipy, rtree)

nodes.label: Jarvis Personal AI Assistant
nodes.rationale: Local, single-user assistant with Claude as the brain; text and voice share one brain and conversation.

nodes.label: Claude Pro Subscription via Claude Code
nodes.norm_label: claude pro subscription via claude code
nodes.rationale: Chosen over API key: no extra cost beyond Pro; gray area acceptable only because personal, local, single-user. ANTHROPIC_API_KEY must be unset or Claude Code bills the key.

nodes.label: Never Add ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
nodes.rationale: Jarvis uses the Claude Pro login.

nodes.label: API-Key Brain Placeholder (brain_api.py)
nodes.rationale: Not implemented; documented so the brain can be swapped later for speed and no 5-hour limits, at extra cost.

nodes.label: Voice Pipeline (VAD, faster-whisper STT, Piper TTS)
nodes.norm_label: voice pipeline (vad, faster-whisper stt, piper tts)

nodes.label: Brain Protocol (swappable brain interface)
nodes.rationale: Everything else talks to an abstract Brain so the Pro-backed and API-backed brains are interchangeable.

nodes.label: Persistent ClaudeSDKClient Session
nodes.rationale: Avoids restarting Claude Code every turn, which matters for voice latency.

nodes.label: Usage Settings (JARVIS_EFFORT, JARVIS_CONNECTORS, JARVIS_NEW_CHAT_AFTER_IDLE_MIN)
nodes.rationale: Thinking was the biggest single use of the Pro limit; each connector adds its tool list to every conversation.

nodes.label: No __init__.py in backend/mcp
nodes.rationale: An __init__.py would make a local 'mcp' package shadowing the real mcp library the Agent SDK depends on.

nodes.label: New Chat / Idle Reset
nodes.rationale: Big conversations idle past cache lifetime (1h) restart, since continuing re-sends everything at full price.

nodes.label: Jarvis Architecture (React frontend + FastAPI backend over WebSocket)
nodes.norm_label: jarvis architecture (react frontend + fastapi backend over websocket)

nodes.label: Bind Backend to 127.0.0.1 Only
nodes.rationale: Local-only, never exposed on 0.0.0.0.

nodes.label: Read / Act Tool Labels
nodes.rationale: Read tools run freely; act tools pause for user confirmation.

nodes.label: AI Core Orb Visual Identity
nodes.rationale: Glowing cyan sphere motif suggests a JARVIS-like assistant 'brain' core; cyan/teal palette signals a sci-fi HUD aesthetic.

nodes.label: Favicon (glowing cyan orb)
nodes.rationale: Single 32x32 circle filled with an off-center radial gradient (pale cyan #bdf4ff highlight to #4cc9f0 to deep teal #0d5e78) giving a lit 3D sphere/orb look; evokes a Jarvis-style AI core glow used as the app browser-tab icon.
